name: Never Ask Me About My Business

meta.wiki: Never Ask Me About My Business

summary: Narain Soothfancy sends you to Gadgetzan to find a chicken weighing five hundred pounds. At the inn, Dirge Quikcleave can point you toward one.

sections.title: Planning and Fetching
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy wants no more questions about his business. It deals in things beyond your understanding, so he keeps the plan to himself and leaves the fetching to you. He needs a chicken weighing five hundred pounds. Dirge Quikcleave at the Gadgetzan inn can point you toward one.

sections.title: Dirge's Answer
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave says no chicken that heavy can be found now. He once knew of the Black Chicken of Death, but nobody who saw that bird lived to tell of it. Then Dirge offers an idea that could be good for you both.

faq.q: Why does Narain Soothfancy need a five-hundred-pound chicken?
aliases: why does narain want a chicken
faq.answer: Narain will not say. His business involves things you could not understand, such as a psychotronic muzzledorf. He keeps the planning to himself and leaves the fetching to you.

faq.q: Who do you need to talk to in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Narain sends you to Dirge Quikcleave at the Gadgetzan inn to begin looking for a suitable chicken.
Translating the Ledger comes first. Narain Soothfancy brings up the chicken afterward.
